description:
FILED s543t (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28) from its timing leg (scratch/s543t/legs/bench.log in the s543t worktree; base cababb9d vs the s543t tree, one exclusive leg at load 1.9).

THE COST, FLAGGED in s543t's report: bench-exec gcdrec 0.0766 -> 0.0828 s (+8.1 %), subret 0.0704 -> 0.0763 (+8.4 %), fibret 0.3606 -> 0.3749 (+4.0 %), anoncall 0.2098 -> 0.2166 (+3.2 %); a 25M-call loop of `sub f { $_[0] + 1 }` +6.2 %; a sub that MATCHES, called in a loop, +15.1 % (the lazy snapshot + restore).  All of it is p-sub-frame's %p-match-scope: `(let ((*p-match-saved* :unsaved)) (multiple-value-prog1 BODY (unless (eq *p-match-saved* :unsaved) (%p-match-restore ...))))` around every named and anonymous sub body.

THE LEVER: a frame needs the scope only when its OWN body can record a match -- a callee's frame restores its own changes.  p-sub-frame is a macro, so it can walk BODY at macroexpansion time and omit the scope when the body contains no match operation (the regex op forms the emitter writes: the =~ / !~ family, s///, a split with a pattern if it records, and every form that runs code inline in the frame: a string eval, `do FILE` / `require`, sort / map / grep blocks are already inline and so already walked).  Nested anonymous subs are their own frames (a match inside one makes the walk conservative, which is harmless).  THE RISK is a closed set that drifts (rule 11): the set of match-recording forms must be ONE registry the walk and the runtime share -- %p-match-record has six call sites (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp), each inside a function an emitted form names; derive the set from those, and add a gate row that fails when a new %p-match-record caller is not in it.

MEASURE: the same leg (bench/ab.pl's sub-call / sub-match rows + bench-exec gcdrec subret fibret anoncall) before -> after; the guard rows Pl/t/match-vars-01.t row 52, Pl/t/bigint-01.t row 15 must stay green; the full sweep (sort.t 174 175).
subject: PERF: p-sub-frame's match scope (#932's sub half, s543t) costs EVERY sub call one special binding + one compare (+3-8 % on the call-heavy bench rows) -- expand %p-match-scope only for a body that can perform a match itself
triage_reason: speed of ordinary sub calls (Target A); the semantics stay as s543t shipped them
